entries.zh: 看山人——堪舆先生、风水先生，专为坟茔择地看山；西文注谓“占卜者，即巫师”
entries.en: geomancer; a diviner who inspects mountains/sites for graves (feng-shui master for burials), glossed by the Spanish as a conjurer or sorcerer (agoreros... hechiceros)
entries.notes: 西文词头义为“为其坟墓占卜之人，即巫师”，与“看山人”风水择地之义相合

entries.zh: 八月（西历 Agosto）；原文以农历七月对译
entries.en: August; the dictionary pairs the Spanish month with the Chinese lunar seventh month (qiyue)
entries.notes: 农历七月通常正当公历八月，属历法对应而非误植

entries.zh: 中——合意、切中；谓恰合其心，即“中意”之“中”
entries.en: to suit, to hit the mark; to please, be agreeable (agradar)
to be pleased with; to one's liking (zhongyi)

entries.zh: 中主意——合乎（其）心意、投合主意
entries.en: to suit (one's) mind or intention; to be agreeable
to be pleased with; to one's liking (zhongyi)

entries.zh: 报答——回报、酬谢；西文注谓“即报偿、酬报”
entries.en: to repay, requite; to return thanks (agradecer, glossed in Spanish as 'to pay, retribution')

entries.zh: 报答所受供奉（字作“报供”，末字与其对音不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: to repay or give thanks by offering in return (agradecer); second character uncertain - written 供 'offering', its sound suggests 应/义
entries.notes: 汉字“供”与对音（近 yi/ying，疑“应/义”）不合；按西语 agradecer 与“报”字定为报答回谢之义，末字存疑

entries.zh: 报恩——报答恩情、知恩图报
entries.en: to repay a favor or kindness; to requite grace received (agradecer el beneficio)

entries.zh: 报义——报答情义、以义相酬
entries.en: to requite a moral debt; to repay with loyalty or righteousness (baoyi)
to repay kindness and fidelity (bao enyi)

entries.zh: 报恩豪——厚报其恩（据前二字“报恩”定，末字存疑）
entries.en: to repay a debt of gratitude generously; final character uncertain - written 豪 'grand', the sound suggests 德/特
entries.notes: 末字“豪”与其音写（近 te，似“德/特”）不合，据“报恩”与西语词头定释义

entries.zh: 报恩德——报答恩德、感戴恩惠
entries.en: to repay kindness or grace received (bao ende)
entries.notes: 官话对音栏三字与其余各栏不合（近似第 14 条“有义人”之对音，疑串行），据汉字、闽南音写与西语词头释义

entries.zh: 有义人——有情有义之人、知恩感戴者
entries.en: a grateful man; a man of righteousness and fidelity (agradecido hombre)

entries.zh: 承惠——承蒙惠赐、领受馈赠（谢人所赠的客气语）
entries.en: to receive (your) kind gift; to be obliged for the present (chenghui)

entries.zh: 承恩——蒙受恩泽、承领恩惠
entries.en: to receive grace or favor (cheng en)

entries.zh: 仁义——仁爱与情义；知恩重义之德（西文以“感谢、感恩之情”对译）
entries.en: benevolence and righteousness; loyalty and the grateful sense of obligation (agradecer and agradecimiento)

entries.zh: 人情——情分、恩义；受人之惠所负的情谊
entries.en: favor and gratitude; human feeling, the social debt of kindness (agradecimiento)

entries.zh: 认恩人——认得恩人、感念其恩之人（知恩图报者）
entries.en: a grateful man; one who acknowledges his benefactor (agradecido)
